description: The minimal banked inputs that rebuild the TWO Hadamard matrices of order 2060 compared in cert 07: '2060-plain' (the plain Goethals-Seidel array over the raw Z_515 seed) and '2060-gist' (the x104-twisted array, which is byte-for-byte the publicly posted H(2060)). Both are generated by ONE quadruple of length-515 +-1 sequences; only the array orientation differs.
encoding: normalised_seed[q] is a string of 515 characters, '+' = +1 and '-' = -1, indexed by u in Z_515

conventions.circulant: circ(x)[i][j] = x[(i - j) mod v]; built as row 0 = x[(-j) mod v] then row i = a right rotation by i
conventions.twist: twist(x, k)[i][j] = circ(x)[i][(k*j) mod v] -- the character/multiplier twist by k. THE TWIST CONVENTION: it acts on the COLUMN index of the circulant by multiplication by k in Z_v, applied AFTER developing x into circ(x). k = 104 here; 104 is a power of the multiplier generator 149 of the relevant multiplier group.
conventions.relabel: relabel(X, inv)[i][j] = X[inv[i]][inv[j]] -- the SAME permutation on rows and on columns of every block, hence a plain (row permutation, column permutation) pair and already inside the Hadamard-equivalence group
conventions.block_rows: the 4x4 grid of 515x515 blocks is flattened row-major: row 515*I + p is the concatenation of block[I][J][p] for J = 0..3

plain_array.what: the plain Goethals-Seidel array over the raw Z_515 seed
plain_array.pin_source: lab cert 0013 run.py PLAIN_SHA / seed515.json plain_gs_canonical_sha256

gist_array.what: the x104-twisted array; byte-for-byte the publicly posted H(2060)
gist_array.crt_relabel_rule: ORD[g] = 5*(g mod 103) + (g mod 5), a bijection Z_515 -> Z_515
gist_array.crt_relabel_note: applied to every block AFTER assembly, as relabel(block, inv) with inv the inverse of ORD; identical on rows and columns, so it is an equivalence-group element and cannot change any invariant
gist_array.pin_source: lab cert 0013 run.py GIST_SHA / cert 0012 RAW_SHA / seed515.json gist_canonical_sha256

provenance: decoded firsthand from certs/0012-public-h2060-intake/H2060.txt.gz; no external table or peer input was used
